stem: An ant crawled \(\frac{2}{8}\) yard from an ant mound. On which number line does point A represent the ant’s position after crawling \(\frac{2}{8}\) yard?

options.label: A
options.text: Number line with point A at the \(\frac{4}{8}\) mark between 0 and 1 yard

options.label: B
options.text: Number line with point A at the \(\frac{1}{8}\) mark between 0 and 1 yard

options.label: C
options.text: Number line with point A at the \(\frac{2}{8}\) mark between 0 and 1 yard

options.label: D
options.text: Number line with point A at the \(\frac{3}{8}\) mark between 0 and 1 yard

visual_elements: Four number lines each labeled from 0 to 1 yard with different points labeled A at various fraction marks: (A) at \(\frac{4}{8}\), (B) at \(\frac{1}{8}\), (C) at \(\frac{2}{8}\), and (D) at \(\frac{3}{8}\). Each has an ant and an ant mound at the start of the line.
difficulty_rationale: The task requires simple understanding of fractions and locating the fraction \(\frac{2}{8}\) on a number line, a straightforward skill for grade 3.
